queens.special: Once per game during Transformation, equip one eligible Fashion card from your Backstage Archive as though it were in your hand. Resolve its Play ability normally and ignore any additional effect cost specifically required to equip that card.

queens.name: Opulencia
queens.ability: Whenever a card you play generates one or more printed Tips, gain 1 additional Tip. Whenever another single effect causes you to gain one or more Tips, gain 1 additional Tip. This bonus cannot trigger itself.
queens.special: Once per game during Shopping, reduce the cost of one Wardrobe purchase by 4 Tips, minimum 0. If the purchased card is Gilded Cage, draw 1 card afterward. Because Transformation has already ended, that drawn card normally cannot be played to generate its printed Tips this turn.

queens.name: Velvet Venom
queens.ability: When you equip a Necropolis Body as Master, choose an opponent; they discard 1 card from hand to their Backstage Archive if able.
queens.special: Once per game when an opponent targets you with a hostile effect, cancel that effect. That opponent then loses 1 Tip, minimum 0.

queens.name: Maldita Manila
queens.ability: Once per turn when you reveal a Complete Coordinate containing at least two non-Neutral Tenets, gain 2 Tips.
queens.special: Once per game during The Reveal, choose two non-Neutral Tenets represented in your Coordinate. For this Reveal, effects that check your Look's Tenet may treat it as either chosen Tenet. This does not satisfy a named Brand requirement by itself.

queens.name: Hexa Laroux
queens.ability: Whenever you gain Gross SP, gain that many Tips. Once per turn during The Reveal, if you have an Accessory equipped, gain 1 Gross SP.
queens.special: Once per game during The Reveal, if all four core slots are occupied, choose one Master and one other Master. Add the first Master's printed Appeal to the second Master's contribution for this Reveal only.

queens.name: Bubblegum Banshee
queens.ability: When you equip Sugar Rush Shoes as Master, draw 1 card.
queens.special: Once per game during Shopping, draw 3 cards, keep 1 in hand, and archive the other 2. If the kept card is Pink, gain 1 Tip before Shopping ends.

queens.name: Siren Diesel
queens.ability: When you equip Shoes as Master, gain 1 Tip.
queens.special: Once per game when you enter Dragdagulan†, each of your three battle-drawn cards gains +1 LS for that battle.

queens.name: Opal Dynasty
queens.ability: Once per Round when you reveal a Complete Coordinate, gain 2 Gross SP.
queens.special: Once per game during The Reveal, choose one Master and treat it as Wild for this Reveal. Assign it one active non-Neutral Tenet under the normal Wild rules.

queens.name: Rapture Royale
queens.ability: Once during Transformation, trash 1 eligible card from your hand; if you do, gain 1 Gross SP.
queens.special: Once per game during Transformation, trash up to 2 eligible cards from your hand. Gain 2 Tips and 1 Appeal for each card trashed this way.

queens.name: Gore-Jess
queens.ability: Once per Round after you win Dragdagulan†, gain 1 Gross SP. If you won by 3 or more Battle Score, gain 2 Gross SP instead.
queens.special: Once per game after you win Dragdagulan†, you may take 2 Gross SP instead of the normal winner reward. If you won by 5 or more Battle Score, take 3 Gross SP instead. Her normal Final Girl Signature Ability still resolves if its condition was met.

stages.spotlight: Slay with a Swamp Witch Master.

stages.spotlight: Slay with at least 1 Thrift Store card equipped.

stages.spotlight: Slay with a Velvet Trap Face or Wig Master.

stages.ovation: +2 Gross SP with a 4-piece Featured Brand Coordinate.

stages.subtitle: Summer Freakshow
stages.venue: Each Big Top Master in your Look gains +1 Appeal.
stages.spotlight: Slay with a Big Top Face or Wig Master.
stages.ovation: +2 Gross SP with a 4-piece Featured Brand Coordinate.

stages.name: Couture House Runway
stages.subtitle: Fashion Week Venue
stages.venue: Each Gilded Cage Master gains +1 Appeal during the Reveal.
stages.spotlight: Slay with all four core slots occupied by non-Neutral Masters.

stages.spotlight: Slay with at least 2 Hyper-Glitch Masters.
stages.ovation: +2 Gross SP with a 4-piece Featured Brand Coordinate.

automa.name: Front Row Favorite
automa.effect: If its Brand matches the Featured Brand, +1 House Appeal.

automa.name: Sample Sale Snatch
automa.effect: If its Cost is 2 or less, the House gains momentum.

automa.name: Brand Obsession
automa.effect: If a Featured Brand card was removed, +1 House Appeal.

automa.name: Complete the Look
automa.effect: If House Wardrobe reaches 4+ slots, +1 House Appeal.

automa.name: Standing Ovation
automa.effect: If the House already owns a Stage, +1 House Appeal.

automa.name: Main Character Energy
automa.effect: The player cannot reduce House Appeal this round.

automa.name: Sold Out
automa.effect: The player's first purchase costs +1 Tip this turn.

automa.name: VIP Rope
automa.effect: Player may buy at most 1 card this Shopping phase.

automa.name: She Knows Every Word
automa.effect: House is especially dangerous in Dragdagulan†.

automa.name: Death Drop
automa.effect: Big House battle wins are more punishing.

automa.name: Wardrobe Malfunction
automa.effect: Targets the player's Signature Tenet when possible.

automa.name: House Always Wins
automa.effect: If neither side Slays, House gains 1 Gross SP.
